hacker-selected-viral-debuff-and-infecti.head: c2205bdf
hacker-selected-viral-debuff-and-infecti.scope: All four stock requests exercised no-target and ally reason 24, range reason 34, ordinary hit, forced viral deflection and post-cast sight refusal. Code Rot and Overheat applied only their modifier records. Both Infection tiers ran eleven ticks on neutral and resisted NPCs.

damage.source: GOB 350 stores a 100-point ViralDOT, ticking every 2.5 seconds for 30 seconds. The loaded source influence and typed viral mitigation apply independently.
damage.runtime: TempMods snapshots the total at landing. TimedEffects runs the stored cadence and applies typed NPC resistance on each tick.
damage.test: VectorVirusDealsElevenRoundedViralTicksBeforeExpiry checks neutral cadence and expiry at the raw baseline. In PR822 the full rank-26 stock profile raises the snapshot to 104 and yields eleven raw 9 ticks. The +75 resist target takes final 6 per tick, with no twelfth tick. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/822#issuecomment-7086666447

targeting.source: GOB 350 uses selected hostile targeting, its stored range and a viral test.
targeting.runtime: AbilityHandler preflights the loaded live view and range, binds the same target through casting and uses the common line-of-sight and viral contest at landing.
targeting.test: PR822 stock refused no target and ally with reason 24 and 21.5 m with reason 34 before spending IS. The selected NPC takes the DOT after the two-second cast; deflection and paid sight failure both leave the target unaffected. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/822#issuecomment-7086666447
